g.text: A dashed amber cell repeats the previous place: that step is a wait. Grey cells: the AGV has arrived and stays at its goal.

g.text: The same plan as figure 1.6, written as the MAPF solution Π that the algorithms work with. Row = one AGV's path; column = one time step. Collision-free: no column

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: contains the same place twice, and no two AGVs swap places between neighbouring columns.
